source.author: lucan
source.text: Non duro liceat morientia cespite membra Ponere, non anima glebam fugiente ferire, Atque oculos morti clausuram quaerere dextram Coniugis illabi lacrimis, unique paratum Scire rogum.
source.text_original: Non duro liceat morientia cespite membra / Ponere, non anima glebam fugiente ferire, / Atque oculos morti clausuram quaerere dextram / Coniugis illabi lacrimis, unique paratum / Scire rogum.
source.text_english: May it not be granted to place the dying limbs on hard turf, nor to strike the clod with the departing breath, and to seek a hand that will close the eyes in death, to fall into a spouse’s tears, and to know that one funeral pyre is prepared for both.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_original: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque / auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_english: Give me, I beg, your embrace, and leave your words to cling to my ears, and now at last close my eyes with your sweet right hand.
